title: Volunteer Shift Timetable
text:
Mia: Hi, Leo. This is my volunteer shift. I help at the food bank on Saturdays.
Leo: Nice. What time do you start?
Mia: We start at nine. We open at nine thirty.
Leo: Do you work alone?
Mia: No, I don't. We work in a team. I sort cans. You can help too.
Leo: Great. I have free time on Saturday mornings. Do you finish at noon?
Mia: No, we don't. We finish at one. We take a break at eleven.
Leo: How often do you volunteer?
Mia: I volunteer every week. My sister volunteers twice a month.
Leo: Perfect. I can come this Saturday.
Mia: Good. Please arrive at eight forty-five.
